title: X12-820 Payment Order/Remittance Advice Parser — parse_820
text: Parses X12-820 (005010X218) transactions Medicaid/Medicare capitation premium payments. Designed California DHCS PACE capitation remittances handles general 820 format used state Medicaid agencies.

title: X12-820 Payment Order/Remittance Advice Parser — parse_820
X12-820 Payment Order/Remittance Advice Parser — parse_820
X12-820 Payment Order/Remittance Advice Parser — parse_820
X12-820 Payment Order/Remittance Advice Parser — parse_820
text: Key segments parsed: ISA/GS: Interchange group headers (source ID, report date) BPR: Payment amount effective date TRN: EFT/check trace number N1/N3/N4: Payer payee name address ENT: Per-member entity loop start NM1: Member name ID RMR: Remittance line item (reference number, payment amount) REF*18: Rate code (e.g., "957" = PACE rate) REF*ZZ: Aid code/plan type composite description DTM*582: Coverage period date range ADX: Adjustment amount reason code Typical loop structure within 820: Header: ISA > GS > ST > BPR > TRN > N1*PE > N1*PR Per-member: ENT > NM1 > (RMR > REF*18 > REF*ZZ > REF*ZZ > DTM*582 > ADX) Trailer: SE > GE > IEA
